1.1: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
1.14: And the Word became flesh, and dwelt among us; and we saw His glory, glory as of the only Son from the Father, full of grace and truth.

3.16: For God so loved the world, that He gave His only Son, so that everyone who believes in Him will not perish, but have eternal life.
3.17: For God did not send the Son into the world to judge the world, but so that the world might be saved through Him.
